ModMetaData.name: City Economy (Community)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Romance-of-the-Three-Kingdoms flavour for Rim War: settlements get a real economy and defenses.

- Every Rim War tracked NPC settlement carries real wealth (silver, food, goods) and fortifications (defense level and points) that grow over time with the city.
- Warband sieges are blunted by city defenses; when a city is sacked, its actual wealth is plundered, not just abstract points.
- Settlement trade stock scales with the city's wealth, and trading with a settlement feeds back into its economy.
- If Settlement Lords (Community) is installed, a capable governing lord accelerates the city's wealth growth; without it the mod works standalone.

Requires Harmony and Rim War. Named Officers / Settlement Lords are optional. Safe to add to existing saves.
